example.title: Stone Arch Bridge, Bicycle Bridge Road over the Wabash and Erie Canal

brief: Single segmental stone arch of 1901 carrying a county road over a small watercourse (the abandoned canal): rock-faced limestone voussoirs and coursed rubble spandrels, a low solid stone parapet with a flat coping, and short wing walls, with a striped hazard marker and historical-marker sign at the end. Grass banks, towpath trail and trees; small-town edge setting.
